"''Yes, mistress.|Asajj Ventress and the [[OOM command battle droid|droid commander]]|}} This '''OOM command battle droid''' was serving as a [[commander]] for the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Battle of Teth]]. ==Biography== During the [[Battle of Teth]] in [[22 BBY]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|separatist]] ground team under [[Asajj Ventress]] tried to retake a [[B'omarr Order Monastery]] that was captured by [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] forces. After storming an entrance and [[Death|killing]] most of the [[Clone trooper|clones]] that were present, this [[OOM command battle droid]] was assigned to eliminate the rest of the clones while Ventress would go take on the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. They were then ordered to seal the main gate and all portals, so nothing could escape the monastery. However, after affirming the command, they were shot in the head by [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], who survived the attack, after which Ventress snatched the [[blaster]] from Rex and captured him. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:OOM command battle droids]] [[Category:Separatist officers]]
